description: Ministry of City Planning and Water Supply - Order made to approve the acquisitions of the immovable Properties in Mullegama, NawagattegamaD/S Division, Puttalam District for the Constructions Under Anamaduwa Water Supply Project and in Badulupitiya and in Anagal Aarawa Kumbura (Mediriya Road) for the  Constructions under Badulla, Urban waste water and Sewerage Project and in Thihariya, Warakapola D/S Division, Kegalle District for the Constructions under Warakapola Watter Supply Scheme
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains multiple orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply infrastructure projects. Each order includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and the names/addresses of claimants. While a government minister is named, this is incidental to the core land acquisition purpose, and there are no detailed portfolio responsibilities or government structural changes described. The content fits squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it concerns land acquisitions and property matters.
